Remote-shell quoting: heredocs and inline python -c with quotes break on the Threadripper shell (history expansion / .bashrc line 47). Reliable pattern: write the script with the local write tool, then pipe via stdin: cat file | threadripper-ssh 'python3'. Same for new source files: write locally, pipe to 'cat > dest'.
